description: iCDM configuration for longitudinal infant data with age-specific UNC-4D templates. Replace every path under 'templates' and 'common_space' with the local UNC-4D files; the synthetic example overwrites them with generated stand-ins.

targets.note: Label value k = channel k. For FreeSurfer/infant-FreeSurfer parcellations use atlas/icdm_remap_dk84.m and model channels 1-68.

tractography.note: Tractography is upstream of iCDM; use one fixed protocol (algorithm, streamline budget, seeding) for every visit.

reference.note: pooled = one covariate-agnostic prior from all reference visits (required when age is the effect under test); per_age_bin = one prior per template bin (individualized reference only; it encodes age).
